QuestInfo.name: Athena Pierce's Recipe
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School has something to ask of you. Go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School asked you to deliver an Orange Mushroom Juice Recipe to Camila in #m100000000#. She's supposed to take it to Camila herself, but she's far too busy to go that far. Camila is probably in front of the Bowman Instructional School, waiting.
QuestInfo.2: You met Camila in front of the Bowman Instructional School in #m100000000#, and gave her the Orange Mushroom Juice Recipe that Athena Pierce gave you.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 300 Can proceed to the Orange Mushroom Juice Mixer quest

0.0: Could I trouble you for a little help? I was supposed to get this to Camila, but I can't leave right now. I'm waiting for an important call... Could you take this to Camila for me?

yes.0: Thank you. Camila is probably waiting for me in the front of the Bowman Instructional School. Don't keep her waiting any longer!

no.0: Really? I could go myself...but then I'd miss my call. And that would just be rude, you know?

1.0: Oh, hello! I don't think I've seen you around #m100000000# before. What's up?\r\n#L0##bI came to deliver the 'Orange Mushroom Juice Recipe' from Athena Pierce.#l\n#k
1.1: Ah! Thank you! I've been waiting for her for awhile...I guess she's just really busy.

npc.0: Camila is probably waiting for me in the front of the Bowman Instructional School.

item.0: Athena Pierce sure is late, isn't she? I thought instructors were supposed to be more responsible...

lost.0: Camila is probably waiting for me in the front of the Bowman Instructional School. Just hurry out there, before she gets impatient!
